messages.text:
Got it, call it 16¢. The H15 Dual is $999 and ships November 14 — it's a drop, so orders open when the team announces it.

Is this your first miner, or adding to a setup?

For a first miner the B30 is the one I'd point you at: $899, ~30 TH/s, about 400 W, so roughly $46 a month in power at 16¢. Ships November 30, 2026.

It's quiet enough for a desk at ~50 dB, and every ten minutes it's drawing for a full 3.125 BTC block — you keep the machine after every draw, and meanwhile it stacks sats straight to your own wallet.

Want me to set one up?

The H15 Dual is the two-algo box — Bitcoin plus Dogecoin/Litecoin in one unit, $999, ships November 14, 2026. The B30 is Bitcoin only, $899, 30 TH/s.

The catch: the H15 is a drop that hasn't opened yet, so you can't check out on it today. The B30 you can buy right now.

If the Doge side is the appeal, I'd wait for the drop. If you just want to mine Bitcoin and learn the thing, take the B30.

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the Harlo H15 Dual numbers for where you live.
